description: Independent, literal, frozen inventory of the 35 accepted claim IDs for the paper-evidence closure. This file is NOT generated from claim_registry_v4.CLAIMS -- it is a hand-authored contract that the registry must match exactly. Per the fourth review's follow-up: 'EXPECTED_CLAIM_IDS = tuple(sorted(c.claim_id for c in CLAIMS))' could not detect a claim silently deleted or renamed from the registry, since it was derived from the very thing it was supposed to check. This file closes that gap: verify_paper_evidence_v4.py loads THIS file's claim_ids list and compares it against the registry's actual claim_ids, in both directions (missing and unexpected).
